_comment: Adjustable template for the Azure quota support ticket.
Quota cases are normally 'minimal'; higher severities need a paid support plan.
preferredTimeZone: Windows time zone id, e.g. 'W. Europe Standard Time'
country: 3-letter ISO 3166 code, e.g. DEU / USA / GBR
phoneNumber and additionalEmailAddresses are optional and are omitted when empty.
quotaChangeRequestSubType stays empty for Compute; it only applies to Batch/SQLMI.
title: vCPU quota increase: {QuotaDisplayName} to {TargetLimit} in {Location}
